mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shop WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop (merchant_id, name, status) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{name}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE shop SET name = #{shop.name}, logo = #{shop.logo}, banner = #{shop.banner}, intro = #{shop.intro} WHERE id = #{shopId} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
